# Which files does OpenCode read?

Rulegate adapter id: `opencode` · Verified against opencode 1.18.32 (source, dev branch) on 2026-09-26 · [Homepage](https://opencode.ai)

Every file below that is present is **sent to the model**, all together. The order ranks specificity rather than authority — nothing here overrides anything else.

## Precedence

| # | Path | Scope | Role | Rulegate writes it | Nesting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `.opencode/opencode.json` | project | settings | yes | root only |
| 2 | `.opencode/opencode.jsonc` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 3 | `.opencode/rules/*.md` | project | instructions | yes | root only |
| 4 | `opencode.json` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 5 | `opencode.jsonc` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 6 | `AGENTS.md` | project | instructions | no | all-merged |
| 7 | `CLAUDE.md` | project | instructions | no | all-merged |
| 8 | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | user-level | instructions | no | root only |
| 9 | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | user-level | instructions | no | root only |
| 10 | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` | user-level | settings | no | root only |

## What each file is

### `.opencode/opencode.json`

A config layer of its own, merged over the root opencode.json, holding only $schema and an instructions list naming the generated rule files. Rulegate owns this file whole and never touches the root config; one it did not write is refused rather than overwritten.

Source: [OpenCode source — config.ts (mergeConfigConcatArrays)](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.opencode/opencode.jsonc`

The JSONC spelling of the .opencode/ config layer. Rulegate writes the .json spelling only; a .jsonc here is imported like the root config and never written.

Source: [OpenCode — Config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.opencode/rules/*.md`

One Markdown file per rule, loaded because .opencode/opencode.json lists it. A file here that is not listed is not loaded. This is what Rulegate generates.

Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `opencode.json`

The user's project config. Its instructions entries are imported (local files only) and it is never written.

Source: [OpenCode — Config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `opencode.jsonc`

The JSONC spelling of the project config. Imported like opencode.json, never written.

Source: [OpenCode — Config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `AGENTS.md`

Every AGENTS.md from the working directory up to the worktree root; when any is found, CLAUDE.md is not read at all. Generated by the codex adapter, not by this one — so enabling opencode and codex together sends OpenCode the same rules twice.

Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `CLAUDE.md`

The Claude Code fallback, read (at every level up to the worktree root) only when no AGENTS.md is found. Generated by the claude-code adapter, not by this one.

Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`

User-level rules. Outside the repository, so Rulegate reports it and never writes it.

Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`

The Claude Code user file, read only when ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md is absent, and unless OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE is set.

Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`

The global config layer. Its instructions are concatenated with the project layers. Reported, never written.

Source: [OpenCode — Config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) — retrieved 2026-09-26

## Size limits

OpenCode documents no size cap on instruction files. The only documented limit is a 5-second timeout on fetching a remote instruction URL.

## Notes

- **warn** — Rulegate owns .opencode/opencode.json entirely and writes only $schema and instructions into it. Put every other setting in the root opencode.json: OpenCode merges the two, and a setting added to the generated file is reported by check as a hand-edit and overwritten only with --force.
  Source: [OpenCode source — config.ts (mergeConfigConcatArrays)](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — instructions arrays are concatenated (and de-duplicated) across config layers rather than replaced, so the list Rulegate writes adds to the root config's list instead of hiding it. The config page says only that layers merge; the concatenation is in the source (mergeConfigConcatArrays).
  Source: [OpenCode source — config.ts (mergeConfigConcatArrays)](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — The generated config carries no "//" marker key: OpenCode's schema rejects unknown keys, so the marker every other generated JSON file carries would make this one invalid. Ownership is recorded in .rulegate/state.json as it is for every artifact.
  Source: [OpenCode source — config.ts (mergeConfigConcatArrays)](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/config/config.ts) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **warn** — Resolution is declared additive, but AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are first-match: when both exist OpenCode reads only AGENTS.md. In a repository with both, doctor bills CLAUDE.md to OpenCode although OpenCode never opens it, so its token estimate for OpenCode runs high.
  Source: [OpenCode — Rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — Relative instructions entries are resolved by searching upward from the working directory to the worktree root, not relative to the config file. Import treats them as repository-relative, and skips remote URLs, home-directory and absolute paths, anything under .agent-os/, .ruler/, .rulesync/ or .rulegate/, and any file another adapter imports (AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/*.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md and the like — matched by the patterns that adapter reads, so .claude/docs/ is still imported), each with a warning. An unlisted file in .opencode/rules/ is not imported, with a warning, because OpenCode does not load it and `init --yes` would replace it if an imported rule takes its name.
  Source: [OpenCode source — instruction.ts (systemPaths)](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/instruction.ts) — retrieved 2026-09-26
